threads: Use case: game-asset. Create a production Minecraft item pixel-art sprite sheet on true transparent alpha background. Exactly five isolated magical THREAD items arranged in a single horizontal row with equal wide gaps between them. Each item is designed on its own strict 16 by 16 logical pixel grid, chunky square hard-edged pixels, no antialiasing, no glow, no floating flecks, no labels, no cell outlines, no background. Similar visual weight and vanilla Minecraft item readability. Each is clearly string or braided thread, not a yarn ball, gemstone or medallion. Five physically different silhouettes, left to right: 1 Ensorcelled Thread: icy blue and pale lavender loose figure-eight loop with one short trailing end. 2 Callous Thread: stout steel-grey twisted two-winding coil with a blunt short tail, visibly thicker than others. 3 Smoldering Thread: warm burnt-red and amber open knotted loop with a curling trailing end; no actual fire. 4 Laced Thread: emerald green braided folded cord with three visibly interwoven strands and a knot on one side. 5 Consecrated Thread: ivory and muted gold neat folded teardrop loop, small tying knot and short doubled tails. Color only on the thread pixels themselves, simple three-tone shading, ancient handmade magical crafting components. Every sprite a connected clean shape. Use the full 16 logical pixel canvas but leave one logical pixel clear padding. Render enlarged with nearest-neighbor pixels so they can be exported at actual 16x16. Do not include wands or tips.
production: Nearest-neighbor crop/format export to 16x16 RGBA. Binary alpha; independent body/tip layers. No combined per-wand PNGs.
